```{python}
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime
from meteostat import config, hourly

config.block_large_requests = False

start = datetime(2020, 1, 1)
end = datetime(2024, 1, 1)

station = "44292"
df = hourly(station, start, end).fetch().reset_index().rename(columns={"time": "date"})

df = df[["date", "temp", "prcp"]].dropna().copy()
df["temp_f"] = (df["temp"] * 9 / 5) + 32
df["month_name"] = df["date"].dt.strftime("%b")
df["month_num"] = df["date"].dt.month

monthly = (
    df.groupby(["month_num", "month_name"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        avg_temp_c=("temp", "mean"),
        total_rainfall_mm=("prcp", "sum")
    )
    .sort_values("month_num")
)

months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
monthly["month_name"] = pd.Categorical(monthly["month_name"], categories=months, ordered=True)

monthly
```

## Key pattern

Mongolia has a much colder winter and a sharper seasonal temperature swing than Sarasota. Rainfall is relatively low overall, but the climate still shows a clear warm-season pulse.

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

# Use the daily temperature records instead of the monthly aggregate.
everyday = df[["date", "temp_f"]].copy()

a = px.scatter(
    everyday,
    x="date",
    y="temp_f",
    color="temp_f",
    title="Daily Temperature in Mongolia",
    labels={"date": "Date", "temp_f": "Temperature (°F)"},
    opacity=0.7,
    trendline="lowess",
    color_continuous_scale=[[0, "#1e3a8a"], [0.5, "#f4d35e"], [1, "#d9480f"]]
)

a.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    width=900,
    height=420,
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=50, b=20),
    title_x=0.5
)
a.show()
```
